contract_silence: B6-11 fixes digit-only ticket numbers but does not fix their JSON type. Tests accept integral digit-only numbers in record/also and preserve the source entry. A parent ruling is needed if strings alone were intended.
The slash in B6-11 bad field/request does not explicitly say whether both names are mandatory. The 12 red cases use the stricter field-name reading and ignore incidental source lines in error stacks.

production_disagreements.state: Measured: 12 diagnostic cases fail. Each invalid input is refused before writes.
production_disagreements.contract_reading: Identifies the bad field/request requires the specific record or also field to be named.
production_disagreements.observed: The diagnostic is Error: case-01: invalid ticket number. It names the request, but not record or also.
production_disagreements.parent_decision: Decide whether naming the request alone meets B6-11. Tests retain the field-name reading until that ruling.
